title: Tomato Thing (Crispy Parmesan-Crusted Pan-Seared Tomatoes)
ingredients: 2 large ripe beefsteak or heirloom tomatoes, sliced into thick 1/2-inch rounds
2 tbsp fresh basil & parsley, finely chopped
Flaky sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Slice the tomatoes into thick 1/2-inch rounds and season lightly on both sides with salt and black pepper.
Combine grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, panko breadcrumbs, minced garlic, and chopped herbs on a plate, then press both sides of the tomato slices firmly into the Parmesan mixture.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the coated tomato slices for 2–3 minutes per side until the Parmesan forms a lacy, golden-brown crust while the tomato center stays juicy and warm.
